title: Nutrition During the Menstrual Cycle
subtitle: Definitions, common causes, evidence-based management, and safety related to nutrition during the menstrual cycle.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports iron supplementation and hydration; moderate evidence for magnesium and vitamin B6 in PMS management; emerging evidence for omega-3 fatty acids; limitations include variability and need for further research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
